description_en: Queries the audit logs of Hive metadata
description_zh: 查看Hive元数据的审计日志
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-emr-hive-audit-logs --cluster-id C-D033DD5FB82436A6 --database-name default --page-number 2 --page-size 2 --table-name test_table --start-time 1586509407 --end-time 1586509710 --api-version 2018-06-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEmrHiveAuditLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EMR cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The start time as a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. The difference between EndTime and StartTime must be less than or equal to 86400.
Both StartTime and EndTime can be left empty. In this case, audit logs within the time range (current - 86400, current) are returned
parameters.help_zh:
表示开始时间（10位时间戳），EndTime-StartTime需要满足小于等于86400。
两个输入值可以同时为空，返回（current-86400, current）时间段内的审计日志
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time as a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. The difference between EndTime and StartTime must be less than or equal to 86400.
Both StartTime and EndTime can be left empty. In this case, audit logs within the time range (current - 86400, current) are returned
parameters.help_zh:
表示结束时间（10位时间戳），EndTime-StartTime需要满足小于等于86400。
两个输入值可以同时为空，返回（current-86400, current）时间段内的审计日志
parameters.name: end_time
